title: Make good decisions quickly
summary: Most product decisions can be reversed, so they should be made quickly. A few cannot, and deserve care. Knowing the difference speeds teams up.

beginner: Ask if the decision can be undone.
Write down what you decided and why.
intermediate: Sort decisions into reversible and hard to reverse.
Decide reversible ones quickly, with the people closest to the work.
For hard ones, gather evidence, consult and agree a single approver.
experienced: Look for ways to make one-way decisions reversible, such as pilots.
Review decision quality, not just outcomes.

toolExamples.confluence: Use a DACI page for hard-to-reverse decisions.
toolExamples.notion: Keep a decision log with date, decision, reason and review date.
